user.title: Estimate a camera direction
user.description: Select an existing ONVIF camera and detection sensors. Replace the synthetic example sectors with your own calibration. This helper reads status only.

error.invalid_camera: Select a camera from the built-in ONVIF integration.
error.camera_unavailable: Load and connect the built-in ONVIF camera before configuring this helper.
error.unsupported_device: This camera exposes no PTZ-capable profile. Read-only position estimates are unsupported.
error.invalid_config: Check detection sources, JSON sectors and timing. Sectors need unique non-overlapping ranges within [-1, 1]. Retry interval must be at least the poll interval.

abort.already_configured: This ONVIF device already has a direction helper.

init.title: Detection and calibration
init.description: Bounds: poll 0.5–60; confirmation 0.5–120; retry 1–300; timeout 0.5–30; position age 1–120; future skew 0–30 seconds. Saving reloads the helper and clears confirmation.
